task: Order analytics with a custom Collector, partitioning/grouping and composable predicate rules
reasoning_summary: Modelled orders as immutable records and statistics as an immutable monoid (EMPTY identity, associative combine) so a Collector.of with a one-element array accumulator is parallel-safe. Used groupingBy with TreeMap for stable ordering, partitioningBy for the split, and defensive List.copyOf in predicate combinators. 22 tests passed on the first run.
